Implementing YAECE on Your 2027 FRC Robot

A verified developer handbook for Yet Another Encounter Control Engine (YAECE)—from vendordep installation and game-agnostic season JSON authoring to sensor-agnostic 6-DoF tracking, dynamic scoring intervals/multipliers, live alliance/opponent score reconciliation, and driver-overridable Commands v3 execution.

Verified Release Status (v2027.5.0-alpha1): All nine packages across Phases 1–5 are implemented, audited 1:1 against source, and verified green with 33/33 JUnit 5 tests passing on Windows 11 (WPILib 2027.0.0-alpha-7, OpenJDK 25, Gradle 9.4.1, Spotless 8.0.0, -Xmx256m).

What You Wire vs. What YAECE Handles Automatically

YAECE is strictly sensor-agnostic: zero required cameras, LiDARs, or third-party runtime JARs. You supply a season JSON file describing the game rules and a periodic stream of Pose3d observations from whatever sensors you already run. YAECE handles alliance mirroring, Hungarian GNN multi-target tracking, pin-foul prevention, restricted-zone clamping, dynamic scoring windows/multipliers, score reconciliation, and points-per-second arbitration.

Step 1: Install the YAECE Vendordep

YAECE targets WPILib 2027 (2027.0.0-alpha-7), Java 25, and Commands v3 (WPILib 2027 Changelog). It ships zero third-party runtime JARs, so it will never conflict with Jackson, EJML, or vendor libraries.

  1. Online install (GitHub Pages): In VS Code press Ctrl+Shift+P → WPILib: Manage Vendor Libraries → Install new libraries (online) and paste the URL on the right.
  2. Local desktop testing (before pushing Pages): Run .\gradlew.bat publishToMavenLocal inside your YAECE clone, then add mavenLocal() and implementation 'io.github.holyartist31656.yaece:yaece-commands3:2027.5.0-alpha1' to your robot project.
# Online Vendordep URL (GitHub Pages)
https://holyartist31656.github.io/YAECE/vendordeps/yaece_commands3.json

# Exact Gradle coordinate (matches vendordeps/yaece_commands3.json)
io.github.holyartist31656.yaece:yaece-commands3:2027.5.0-alpha1

# Required WPILib 2027 stack in your robot project:
# - Java 25 toolchain (C:\Users\Public\wpilib\2027_alpha7\jdk)
# - org.wpilib:commandsv3-java:2027.0.0-alpha-7 (do NOT mix with Commands v2)
# - Optional: YAMS/YAGSL, QuestNav, PhotonVision, Limelight, or custom coprocessor

Step 2: Author Your Season JSON (Including Optional Scoring Intervals)

Place your season file in src/main/deploy/yaece/season_2027.json or load one of the two bundled classpath configs: /yaece/seasons/season_2026_rebuilt.json (calibrated to the FRC 2026 REBUILT Game Manual) or /yaece/seasons/sample_2027_template.json. Author every coordinate once in canonical Blue-alliance space—YAECE mirrors sites, approach offsets, staging poses, obstacles, restricted zones, and defense corridors to Red automatically.

Game-Agnostic scoringIntervals[] (Optional)

For seasons with predictable clock-based bonus periods (e.g., 2× Endgame multipliers or flat bonuses), add an optional scoringIntervals array to your JSON. Seasons that omit it default to always-active 1.0× scoring with zero extra fields.

Runtime dynamicAvailabilityKey (Optional)

For match-determined windows like 2026 REBUILT's 25-second Active/Inactive HUB shifts (Section 6.4) or 2024 Amplified Speaker windows, tag sites with a dynamicAvailabilityKey (e.g., "hub_active") and update active status, multipliers, flat bonuses, or time remaining at runtime via YaeceEngine.

// Loading a season file once in RobotContainer (verified v2027.5.0-alpha1 API)
SeasonConfig season = SeasonConfig.fromClasspathResource("/yaece/seasons/season_2026_rebuilt.json");
// Or load from deploy directory on the robot:
// SeasonConfig season = SeasonConfig.fromFile(
//     Filesystem.getDeployDirectory().toPath().resolve("yaece/season_2027.json"));

// Optional static scoringIntervals[] entry in JSON (omit completely if a season has no intervals):
// "scoringIntervals": [
//   {
//     "id": "endgame_double_points",
//     "startElapsedSec": 130.0,
//     "endElapsedSec": 160.0,
//     "matchingSiteTags": ["hub_fuel"],
//     "active": true,
//     "pointMultiplier": 2.0,
//     "flatBonusPoints": 0.0
//   }
// ]

Step 3: Initialize YaeceEngine & Feed Pose3d Observations

Build YaeceEngine once in RobotContainer, turn on any optional NT4 bridges you want, and feed plain Pose3d observations in robotPeriodic().

Calling yaece.updateAndEvaluate(...) handles everything in one step: it polls yaece/console/* and yaece/perception/* (if enabled), steps the 6-DoF world model and 5-robot IMM filter, evaluates dynamic scoring intervals/multipliers, and publishes 3D Struct telemetry to AdvantageScope.

// 1. One-time setup in RobotContainer (verified v2027.5.0-alpha1 API)
YaeceEngine yaece = YaeceEngine.builder(season)
    .withAlliance(AllianceSide.BLUE)
    .withKinematics(RobotKinematicsSpec.FRC_SWERVE_DEFAULT)
    .build();

yaece.enableNetworkTablesConsole();                           // yaece/console/*
yaece.enableAdvantageScopeTelemetry(TelemetryVerbosity.FULL_ADVANTAGESCOPE); // yaece/telemetry/*
// Optional: yaece.enableCoprocessorNtBridge();               // yaece/perception/*

// 2. Every 20 ms in robotPeriodic()
double nowSec = Timer.getFPGATimestamp();
yaece.updateEgoPose(drivetrain.getPose3d(), nowSec);
yaece.feedGamePieces(vision.getLatestGamePiece6DoF());
yaece.feedRobots(vision.getLatestRobotObservations());

// Optional runtime scoring gate / multiplier (e.g., 2026 REBUILT HUB shift)
yaece.setDynamicKeyActive("hub_active", isOurHubActive);
yaece.setDynamicKeyTimeRemaining("hub_active", secondsLeftInShift);
// Optional: yaece.setDynamicKeyMultiplier("hub_active", 2.0);
// Optional: yaece.setDynamicKeyBonusPoints("hub_active", 3.0);

TacticalRecommendation rec = yaece.updateAndEvaluate(
    nowSec,
    RobotInventoryState.holding("fuel", intake.getHeldFuelCount()),
    currentPeriod,
    matchTimeRemainingSec);

Step 4: Track Scores & Wire the Zero-Boilerplate NT4 Contract

MatchScoreLedger reconciles your robot's own scored pieces with optional human Driver Station inputs. Every input is timestamped, so entering an observed scoreboard score at t = 40 s never double-counts pieces your robot scored before t = 40 s—and automatically adds pieces scored after t = 40 s.

Robot-Side Event Recording (1 Line)

Call yaece.recordSelfScored(siteId, pieceId, period, elapsedMatchSec) whenever your outtake/shooter confirms a piece scored. YAECE looks up Auto vs. Teleop points from SeasonConfig automatically.

Opponent Extrapolation & Adaptive Defense

When a co-driver enters opponent scores or piece counts periodically, yaece.getScoreProjection(elapsedSec) fits an exponentially-weighted linear trend to forecast final margin—driving DefenseModeResolver whenever AUTO_ADAPTIVE defense is active.

NT4 Topic Type Direction Verified Runtime Behavior
yaece/console/playMode String DS → Robot Switches live between OFFENSE and DEFENSE.
yaece/console/defenseStrategy String DS → Robot Selects HIGHEST_THREAT, ZONE_DEFENSE, or AUTO_ADAPTIVE.
yaece/console/optimizationObjective String DS → Robot Toggles MATCH_POINTS vs. RANKING_POINTS (auto-spills once RPs lock).
yaece/console/observedAllianceScore double DS → Robot Auto-timestamps on change; reconciles without double-counting prior self scores.
yaece/console/teammateEstimatedPoints double DS → Robot Optional teammate-only point estimate when no full scoreboard entry exists.
yaece/console/objectiveCount/<id> int DS → Robot Timestamped alliance total count toward a specific RP/bonus objective ID.
yaece/console/opponentObservedScore double DS → Robot Appends a timestamped sample to the opponent EWLS score extrapolator.
yaece/console/opponentPieceCount/<id> int DS → Robot Converts estimated opponent scored pieces to points when scoreboard is omitted.
yaece/console/telemetry/* double Robot → DS Publishes reconciledAllianceScore, estimatedOpponentScore, projectedFinalMargin, opponentScoringRatePps.
yaece/perception/* double[] Coprocessor → Robot Optional wire contract (pieces6dof, lidarClusters, cameraBearings) decoded by Coprocessor6DoFNtBridge.
yaece/telemetry/* Struct / String Robot → DS Publishes egoPose, recommendedTarget, gamePieces[], opponents[], allies[], activeIntent, activeTargetId, activeDefenseStrategy, utilityScore, pinBackoffRequired, reason.

Step 5: Run Dual-Mode Tactical Control (Recommend or Automate)

Every 20 ms tick, EncounterArbiter evaluates all legal actions—accounting for held-piece inventory, 6-DoF intake orientation alignment, dynamic site active/inactive windows (with closing-window guard and 3.5 s pre-open staging), arrival-time races against nearby robots, active NO_OPPONENT_CONTACT zones, and per-opponent 3-second pin timers (Rule G418).

// Verified WPILib 2027 Commands v3 Binding Pattern (v2027.5.0-alpha1)
BooleanSupplier driverOverride =
    () -> Math.hypot(driver.getLeftX(), driver.getLeftY()) > 0.12
       || Math.abs(driver.getRightX()) > 0.12;

YaeceExecutionHooks hooks = YamsSwerveHooks.create(
    swerve::driveToPose,
    rec -> swerve.driveAndScore(rec.targetPose3d().toPose2d()),
    rec -> swerve.driveAndIntake(rec.targetPose3d().toPose2d()),
    mechanisms::stowCommand);

// Mode A: Run full YAECE Commands v3 coroutine (cancels all forked children on joystick nudge)
Command autoEncounter = YaeceCommandFactory.runAutonomousEncounter(yaece, hooks, driverOverride);

// Mode B: On-the-fly driver mode toggles (Commands v3 noRequirements coroutine)
Command toggleOffenseDefense = Command.noRequirements(co -> yaece.togglePlayMode()).named("Toggle PlayMode");
Command toggleRpVsPoints     = Command.noRequirements(co -> yaece.toggleOptimizationObjective()).named("Toggle Objective");
Command forceZoneDefense     = Command.noRequirements(
    co -> yaece.setDefenseStrategyMode(DefenseStrategyMode.ZONE_DEFENSE)).named("Force Zone Defense");

Step 6: Pre-Field Verification Checklist (Example Robot & AdvantageScope)

Before running automated encounters on carpet, validate every rule and safety guard in desktop simulation using the companion YAECE-RebuiltSim-Example robot project under SystemCore's memory ceiling (-Xmx256m):

1. Season, Mirroring & Shifts

Run .\gradlew.bat test (33/33 green in YAECE) and launch AdvantageScope 3D connected to localhost. Verify Blue/Red mirroring, Active/Inactive 25 s HUB transitions, closing-window holds, and 3.5 s pre-open staging.

2. Pin Guard & Endgame G420 Clamp

Toggle yaece/console/playMode to DEFENSE in simulation. Confirm YAECE triggers its 1.95 m backoff at t = 2.2 s, holds outside 1.83 m for 3.2 s, and never crosses the opponent's protected TOWER boundary during the final 30 s (Rule G420).

3. Ledger & Driver Override

Push synthetic scoreboard updates via yaece/console/observedAllianceScore and opponentObservedScore. Confirm zero double-counting, verify AUTO_ADAPTIVE flips between HIGHEST_THREAT and ZONE_DEFENSE, and confirm nudging the driver stick cancels automation within one 20 ms tick.

Start with one season JSON file and three lines of Pose3d input—then layer on dynamic scoring shifts, defense, and Commands v3 automation as your robot earns trust on the field.

Phases 6–8 Elite Upgrades (v2027.2.0 – v2027.5.0-alpha1)

Building on the core sensor-agnostic world model and dual-mode arbiter, Phases 6–8 add zero-dependency pathfinding, shot verification, Shoot-on-the-Move physics, deterministic offline replay, scouting priors, and 3D CAD simulation bridging:

  • Phase 6 (v2027.2.0-alpha1) — Pathfinding, Reliability & Safety Gates: FieldPathfinder (epoch-cached visibility-graph A* around StaticObstacleSpec polygons with 3 clearance profiles), ShotReadinessGate (tilt, vision freshness, velocity, and 0.45 s auto fail-safe), HazardAutoTuck (velocity-projected trench/overhead stow trigger), CollisionDetector (sustained speed-ratio drop recovery), VisionPoseGate + EgoPoseBuffer (yaw-rate/Z/tilt odometry gating), PieceDetectionFilter (4-gate debounce, heading cone, moving average), and YaeceDiagnostic (boot-time config validation).
  • Phase 7 (v2027.3.0-alpha1) — Polar Alignment, SOTM & Deterministic Replay: PolarAutoAlignController (polar radial profile, 0.01–0.05 m FF taper, dynamic CG extension derating, omegaOverride, convergence hold timer), ShootOnTheMoveSolver (closed-form SE(2) 0.03 s phase-delay lookahead, launcher-offset velocity kinematics, exponential drag (1 - exp(-tof * k)) / k, analytical aiming omega FF, geometric exclusion zones), and yaece.replay (RecordedTick, YaeceInputRecorder, YaeceReplayHarness for zero-dependency bit-identical JSONL replay).
  • Phase 8 (v2027.5.0-alpha1) — Scouting Priors & YACSim 3D Bridge: yaece.scouting (RobotRolePrior, OpponentProfile, ScoutingPriorRegistry.fromJson(...) via MinimalJson) wired into DefenseInterceptor and YaeceEngine to weight high-scoring opponents and endgame specialists, plus yaece.bridges.YacSim3dBridge unifying YaeceEngine, CG-derated PolarAutoAlignController, ShootOnTheMoveSolver, and YaeceInputRecorder with zero simulator runtime JARs.
